data.name: Modern Tanks: War Tank Games
data.detailed_description:
💥 Epic PvP Tank Battles & Modern Warfare

Prepare for Modern Tanks — a definitive action shooter and combat simulation where military forces clash in a global war universe. Command a heavy armored vehicle, master tactical war maneuvers, and dominate the battlefield in this free to play action hit.

🔥 Real Tank Battle Experience & Shooting

Immerse yourself in a real war game where every shell impact counts. The game offers intense multiplayer action and PvP skirmishes, placing you inside a steel beast ready for total destruction.

Dynamic Deathmatch Modes: Engage in ruthless Head to Head combat where players fight to destroy enemy units for 5 minutes straight. Choose "Team Deathmatch" to lead your platoon squad to a heroic victory or go solo in a free-for-all fight for survival.

9 Maps for Tactical Ops: Navigate your combat vehicle across 9 Maps including the industrial "Korea" oil depot, the sandy dunes of "Sahara", and the snowy streets of "City 2". Every combat zone from the "Military Base" to the "Airport" demands unique combat tactics.

Realistic Ballistics: Master the aim target mechanics and calculate armor penetration to blast through the armor of a hostile tank. Feel the recoil as you fire shell after shell with sniper precision.

⚙️ Upgrade Your War Machines & Garage

Build your legacy in a massive garage upgrade system featuring over 40 Tanks from the mid-20th to the 21st century. Your driving shooter skills are only half the battle; deep customization of your war machines is the key to victory strike.

Huge Vehicle Collection: Unlock and command more than 20 permanent combat vehicles and 10+ event tanks, ranging from light scouts to heavy iron beasts.

Deep Module Upgrades: Improve your tank by upgrading the Cannon for damage, Armor for health, Engine for speed, and Chassis for mobility. A fully maxed turret turns your machine into a legendary destroyer.

Visual Customization: Apply 30+ Camouflages including "Pixel" and "Triangle" patterns to your armored units. Use 15+ Stickers to personalize your hull, making your battle tank stand out in the arena match.

🏆 Join Clans & MMO Community

This is not just a shooting game; it is a MMO community where command strategy meets social competition. Rise through the leaderboards and prove your army clash skills to the world.

Clan Tournaments: Join a Clan and fight for dominance in the Gold, Silver, and Bronze Leagues. Coordinate military operations in regional chat or clan chat to execute the perfect flank.

Global Conflict: Compete in Personal Tournaments across your region, country, or the entire world to become a top soldier command operative.

Daily Rewards: Spin the "Wheel of Fortune" and complete quests to earn bonuses like Silver and Gold, ensuring your military forces are always ready for the next invasion.

🎮 Realistic Physics & 3D Graphics
Witness next generation 3D graphics that bring modern conflict to life. The game engine renders authentic sounds, engine roar, and cinematic moments that rival console simulators.
High-Fidelity Visuals: From the caterpillar tracks churning mud to the blast wave of a heavy strike, every detail contributes to a realistic physics experience.
Smooth Performance: Enjoy seamless driving shooter mechanics and responsive controls even during the most chaotic tank duels.
Atmospheric Audio: Hear the loud explosion of enemy artillery systems and the mechanical hum of your modern steel clash titans.

🚀 Download & Fight!
The frontline defense needs a commander. Download Modern Tanks now and lead your army to total destruction of the enemy in the ultimate war simulator!

data.short_description: Command powerful armored vehicles in a dynamic arcade tank action game! This is a free-to-play third-person PvP game featuring fierce battles of mid-20th to early 21st-century war machines. Choose your class, upgrade your tank, and defeat enemies in intense team battles and solo modes.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™2 Quad Q6600 & AMD Athlon II X4 640 AM3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon RX 460 or Intel HD 630 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.9 (Mavericks)
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 or similar (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Steam OS, Linux Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Quad core CPU 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 630 or similar (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Notes: recent binary ATI or NVidia drivers (MESA may not work reliably)
